reference: Synaxaristes ton dodeka menon (Nikodemos, Athens 1868), vol. I, entry of St Theophilos the New of Zakynthos, martyred at Chios in 1635 (OCR text of the archive.org scan; page about 192–193 of the printed volume)
gist_en: The martyr before the Chios kadi refuses Islam and calls the judge and the Agarenes insulting names; they burn him alive. Only his short confession touches faith.
why_excluded: Its insults against the Agarenes and the judge are personal and ethnic (exclusion rule 3). Its doctrinal content on Islam is a single confession of Christ, with no argument against Muhammad.
